dialogues.jp:
どうしようかなぁとは思ったけれど、やはり気
になった。
dialogues.en:
Thinking of what to do, my thoguhts could only revert to
that.
dialogues.text:
Thinking of what to do, my thoguhts could only revert to
that.

dialogues.jp:
俺がそこまで気にする必要はないとは思ったけ
れど、やはりどこか胸にひっかかるものがあっ
た。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't something I had to worry or think about, yet it
left a funny feeling in my chest.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't something I had to worry or think about, yet it
left a funny feeling in my chest.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、急いで昼飯を食い、体育館の裏にやって
きた。
dialogues.en:
As soon as I finished my lunch, I headed for the back of the
gym.
dialogues.text:
As soon as I finished my lunch, I headed for the back of the
gym.

dialogues.jp:
ここより、２年生の教室を探せばいいような気
もするが、いるとしたら、こっちだと思った。
dialogues.en:
If anything, she'd more likely be found there than in the
classrooms...
dialogues.text:
If anything, she'd more likely be found there than in the
classrooms...

dialogues.jp: 「……いねーか」
dialogues.en: "...But she isn't here."
dialogues.text: "...But she isn't here."

dialogues.jp:
誰もいない、相変わらず殺伐とした場所。月城
どころか人っ子ひとりいない。
dialogues.en:
No one was here in this dark and gloomy place. Not
Tsukishiro, not anyone.
dialogues.text:
No one was here in this dark and gloomy place. Not
Tsukishiro, not anyone.

dialogues.jp: 「バカバカしい。帰ろ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm just being stupid. I should head back..."
dialogues.text: "I'm just being stupid. I should head back..."

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、ヘタな気まぐれなんておこすモノじゃ
あないと実感する。
dialogues.en: I can't just solve weird problems that easily.
dialogues.text: I can't just solve weird problems that easily.

dialogues.jp:
月城がしゃがんでいた場所には、何かの植物が
生えていたけれど、昨日のことを知らなければ、
変わった雑草にしか見えない。
dialogues.en:
The plant was still growing there, but if yesterday hadn't
taken place, I wouldn't have been able to distinguish it.
dialogues.text:
The plant was still growing there, but if yesterday hadn't
taken place, I wouldn't have been able to distinguish it.

dialogues.jp:
俺が、その植物に背を向けて、帰ろうとした時
だった。
dialogues.en:
Turning my back on the plant, I started heading back to
class.
dialogues.text:
Turning my back on the plant, I started heading back to
class.

dialogues.jp: 「の、のわぁッ……って、月城じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "W, wahh..., oh, it's you, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "W, wahh..., oh, it's you, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp: 振り返った目の前に、月城がいた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro had been standing behind me.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro had been standing behind me.

dialogues.jp:
まったく気配を感じさせない状態で、そこにい
たのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
Her presence wasn't even noticable; how long had she been
standing there?
dialogues.text:
Her presence wasn't even noticable; how long had she been
standing there?

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "..Senpai."
dialogues.text: "..Senpai."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、少し考えた素振りを見せた後、もぞも
ぞと手袋を外し、人形を触る。
dialogues.en:
Thinking for a while, she eventually took off her gloves,
and patted her doll.
dialogues.text:
Thinking for a while, she eventually took off her gloves,
and patted her doll.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩、こんちわ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpai, good afternoon!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpai, good afternoon!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「こ、こんちわ……って、これ、月城が喋って
　るんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "H, hello... uh, this is Tsukishiro speaking, right?"
dialogues.text: "H, hello... uh, this is Tsukishiro speaking, right?"

dialogues.jp:
月城がふるふると首を横に振る。綺麗に巻かれ
た縦ロールがゆらゆら揺れる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro calmly shook her head no, her twin curled
ponytails swinging side-to-side with her head.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro calmly shook her head no, her twin curled
ponytails swinging side-to-side with her head.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「だから、喋ってるのは、ボクだって。ピロス
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "Therefore, the one speaking must be me, Piros."
dialogues.text: "Therefore, the one speaking must be me, Piros."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ピロスって、そんなピロシキみたいな名前の
　人形が喋ってるって、そりゃあないぞ。腹話
　術ってヤツだろ？　うまいな」
dialogues.en:
"There's no such thing as a doll, albeit one with a name,
speaking on it's own. It's ventriloquism, no? You're really
skilled."
dialogues.text:
"There's no such thing as a doll, albeit one with a name,
speaking on it's own. It's ventriloquism, no? You're really
skilled."

dialogues.jp:
月城は上目遣いで俺をじーっと見る。口をきゅっ
とへの字に曲げて、じーっと見ている。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's head turned upwards, staring at me. Her mouth
curled into a frown, her eyes still unwavering.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's head turned upwards, staring at me. Her mouth
curled into a frown, her eyes still unwavering.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「腹話術じゃないよ。ボクが喋ってるの！」
dialogues.en: "It's not ventriloquism. I'm really tallking!"
dialogues.text: "It's not ventriloquism. I'm really tallking!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「……わかったよ。わかった。その人形が喋っ
　てるんだろ。そういうことにしよう」
dialogues.en:
"...Alright, alright, I get it. That doll is talking. That's
what's going on."
dialogues.text:
"...Alright, alright, I get it. That doll is talking. That's
what's going on."

dialogues.jp:
どうも、月城……いや、人形は自分で喋ってい
るのだと言い張っている。
dialogues.en:
Somehow, Tsukishiro... I mean, the doll, insisted that it
was the one talking.
dialogues.text:
Somehow, Tsukishiro... I mean, the doll, insisted that it
was the one talking.

dialogues.jp:
多少不思議だが（いや、相当不思議だろう）人
形が喋ろうが、月城が喋ろうが、どっちでもい
いといえばいい。
dialogues.en:
Strange as it may be (although par for the course), whether
it's the doll talking or Tsukishiro talking doesn't really
matter.
dialogues.text:
Strange as it may be (although par for the course), whether
it's the doll talking or Tsukishiro talking doesn't really
matter.

dialogues.jp:
今さらちょっとやそっと不思議なことが起こっ
たって驚きはしない。
dialogues.en:
Considering things that have happened, and are happening
right now, that's not anything to be surprised about.
dialogues.text:
Considering things that have happened, and are happening
right now, that's not anything to be surprised about.

dialogues.jp:
こういう時、自分が不思議な存在の先頭にいる
と楽で助かる。
dialogues.en:
At a time like this, all you really need to do is nod and
smile.
dialogues.text:
At a time like this, all you really need to do is nod and
smile.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「人形じゃないよ！　ピロスだよ。アリスの唯
　一の友達なんだ」
dialogues.en: "My name's not "doll"! It's Piros. Alice's only friend."
dialogues.text: "My name's not "doll"! It's Piros. Alice's only friend."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……わかったよ、ピロスな、ピロス」
dialogues.en: "...Okay, you're Piros, I know."
dialogues.text: "...Okay, you're Piros, I know."

dialogues.jp: 人形のくせに意外とうるさいヤツだ。
dialogues.en: He's a pretty big loudmouth for a doll.
dialogues.text: He's a pretty big loudmouth for a doll.

dialogues.jp:
「ところで、月城。学生手帳、渡してもらえた
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, Tsukishiro. Did you get back your student
notebook?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, Tsukishiro. Did you get back your student
notebook?"

dialogues.jp: アリスが小さく返事をして、こくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en:
Alice's answer was barely audible, her head nodding slightly
once at the same time.
dialogues.text:
Alice's answer was barely audible, her head nodding slightly
once at the same time.

dialogues.jp:
喋れない訳ではなさそうだけれど、なんとなく、
喋るのがとてつもなく苦手、そんな感じだ。
dialogues.en:
She hasn't really had a reason to talk so far, but I get the
feeling that she's probably not very good at it to start
with.
dialogues.text:
She hasn't really had a reason to talk so far, but I get the
feeling that she's probably not very good at it to start
with.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、瀬場さんから受け取ったよ。わざわざ
　家にまで来たんだね」
dialogues.en:
"She recieved it from Seiba-san as soon as we returned
home."
dialogues.text:
"She recieved it from Seiba-san as soon as we returned
home."

dialogues.jp:
月城の腕の中で、表情がまるで変わらない人形
がそう言った。なんとなく、微妙に生意気なヤ
ツだな。
dialogues.en:
The doll in Alice's arms, unchangingly expressionless,
answered for her. Somehow, he seems rather... unsubtle.
dialogues.text:
The doll in Alice's arms, unchangingly expressionless,
answered for her. Somehow, he seems rather... unsubtle.

dialogues.jp:
「なんか、人形に礼を言われるのもなんだか不
　思議なものだな」
dialogues.en: "...Being explained to by a doll is still a weird feeling."
dialogues.text: "...Being explained to by a doll is still a weird feeling."

dialogues.jp:
どうも調子が出ない。月城を相手にしてるのか
その人形を相手にしてるのか、わからなくなる。
dialogues.en:
I'm not in their rhythm at all. The relationship between
Tsukishiro and that doll was still a mess of confusion to
me.
dialogues.text:
I'm not in their rhythm at all. The relationship between
Tsukishiro and that doll was still a mess of confusion to
me.

dialogues.jp: ふと、足下に、じょうろが見える。
dialogues.en:
Trying to distract myself, I idly stared at the water can at
my feet.
dialogues.text:
Trying to distract myself, I idly stared at the water can at
my feet.

dialogues.jp: 「今日も、そこの草の世話？」
dialogues.en: "Still taking care of that plant today?"
dialogues.text: "Still taking care of that plant today?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「とても、大切な花なんだ。絶対にいじったり
　しないでよ？」
dialogues.en:
"It's a very important flower, so of course we'd have to
take care of it extremely well."
dialogues.text:
"It's a very important flower, so of course we'd have to
take care of it extremely well."

dialogues.jp: 月城に続いて、ピロスが答える。
dialogues.en: Piros elaborated further on Alice's terseness.
dialogues.text: Piros elaborated further on Alice's terseness.

dialogues.jp:
「別にいじりやしないさ。つか、花だったんだ
　なこれ」
dialogues.en: "Not saying you shouldn't. But is this really a flower?"
dialogues.text: "Not saying you shouldn't. But is this really a flower?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は踏んづけたり引っこ抜いたりする気はな
いが、その草は風で飛んじゃいそうなくらい、
弱々しいものだった。
dialogues.en:
Even if it wasn't stepped on or whatever, it seems so weak,
that a strong gust of wind could probably blow it into the
air.
dialogues.text:
Even if it wasn't stepped on or whatever, it seems so weak,
that a strong gust of wind could probably blow it into the
air.

dialogues.jp: 月城は、手袋をはめ直し、じょうろを持つ。
dialogues.en: Refitting her gloves, Tsukishiro picked up the watering can.
dialogues.text: Refitting her gloves, Tsukishiro picked up the watering can.

dialogues.jp:
そして、草のところへ行くと、昨日のようにしゃ
がんで、水をやり始めた。
dialogues.en:
Repeating yesterday's routine, she calmly strode over to the
plant, and started to water it.
dialogues.text:
Repeating yesterday's routine, she calmly strode over to the
plant, and started to water it.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、その草、なんて名前なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, that plant... what's it's name?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, that plant... what's it's name?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ちょっと俺の方を向き、口を開きかけ
たが、すぐにまた水やりに戻ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
For a split second, Tsukishiro had turned her head to me and
opened her mouth slightly. But before a word could escape
her lips, her concentration went back to the plant and
watering can.
dialogues.text:
For a split second, Tsukishiro had turned her head to me and
opened her mouth slightly. But before a word could escape
her lips, her concentration went back to the plant and
watering can.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、ピロス、答えろよ」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Piros, can't you answer that?"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Piros, can't you answer that?"

dialogues.jp: 人形の名前を呼んでみる。
dialogues.en: I called out the doll's name.
dialogues.text: I called out the doll's name.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、人形は、月城の腕に、相変わらずにっ
こりと笑った表情のまま静かに抱かれていた。
dialogues.en:
Yet all the doll did was sit in Tsukishiro's arms quietly,
wearing a never-fading smirk.
dialogues.text:
Yet all the doll did was sit in Tsukishiro's arms quietly,
wearing a never-fading smirk.

dialogues.jp: 「もう、喋らないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Not talking anymore?"
dialogues.text: "Not talking anymore?"

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、腹話術だったのだろうか。人形は、
自分はただの人形だと言わんばかりに、ただ
ずっと黙っていた。
dialogues.en:
It must be ventriloquism. It said so much that it could talk
by itself, yet now, it seemed dead as a doornail.
dialogues.text:
It must be ventriloquism. It said so much that it could talk
by itself, yet now, it seemed dead as a doornail.

dialogues.jp: 水をやり終えた月城は、すっと立ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro then stood up, having finished watering the
plant.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro then stood up, having finished watering the
plant.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、……さよなら」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai... farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai... farewell."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、それだけ言うと、じょうろと人形を手
に、てててっと校舎の方に向かって、駆けてい
くのだった。
dialogues.en:
With the watering can in one hand and the doll in the other,
she hurried back to the school building.
dialogues.text:
With the watering can in one hand and the doll in the other,
she hurried back to the school building.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺が一人だけ残される。
dialogues.en: Leaving just myself behind.
dialogues.text: Leaving just myself behind.

dialogues.jp: ひゅう……と足下を風が駆け抜ける。
dialogues.en:
I kicked the ground in a mixture of confusion and
frustration, creating a cloud of dust.
dialogues.text:
I kicked the ground in a mixture of confusion and
frustration, creating a cloud of dust.

dialogues.jp: 「……なんなんだ、あいつ」
dialogues.en: "...The hell is up with that girl?"
dialogues.text: "...The hell is up with that girl?"

dialogues.jp: まったく、よくわからないヤツだ。
dialogues.en: She's completely incomprehensible.
dialogues.text: She's completely incomprehensible.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、ああまでよくわからないと、余計に気
になってしまう。
dialogues.en:
But, even as incomprehensible as it is, I can't help but be
intrigued by it.
dialogues.text:
But, even as incomprehensible as it is, I can't help but be
intrigued by it.

dialogues.jp:
腹話術なのか、本当に不思議な人形なのかわか
らないけれど、あのピロスって人形も気になる
し。
dialogues.en:
Especially of that Piros, whether it's controlled by
ventriloquism or whether he's what he claims he is.
dialogues.text:
Especially of that Piros, whether it's controlled by
ventriloquism or whether he's what he claims he is.

dialogues.jp: ふと、月城が育てている草に目をやる。
dialogues.en: My eyes traveled over to the Tsukishiro's adopted plant.
dialogues.text: My eyes traveled over to the Tsukishiro's adopted plant.

dialogues.jp:
ぎりぎり当たっている太陽の光が、さっきの水
に反射して、キラキラと輝いていた。
dialogues.en:
The faint rays of the sun were reflecting off the residue
drops of water, making the plant look as if it was shining.
dialogues.text:
The faint rays of the sun were reflecting off the residue
drops of water, making the plant look as if it was shining.

dialogues.jp: 「また、気が向いたら、来てみるかな」
dialogues.en: "She'd probably keep coming back here."
dialogues.text: "She'd probably keep coming back here."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、広島銘菓もみじ饅頭を手のひらに転がし、
ひょいっと口に入れた。
dialogues.en:
I thought, as I finally started digging into my lunch of
Hiroshima pastry cakes.
dialogues.text:
I thought, as I finally started digging into my lunch of
Hiroshima pastry cakes.

dialogues.jp: ◆ピロシキ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Piroshiki◆
dialogues.text: ◆Piroshiki◆

dialogues.jp:
月城のことが気になり、体育館裏を訪れた俺は
そこで、再び月城に出会う。
dialogues.en:
Thinking about Tsukishiro, I visited the gym rear and met
her again.
dialogues.text:
Thinking about Tsukishiro, I visited the gym rear and met
her again.

dialogues.jp:
あいかわらず、月城は人形を使って喋るのだっ
た。色々｛き／訊｝いてみたいことがあったのだが、昨
日と同じくあまり喋ってはもらえなかった。
dialogues.en:
As before, she let the doll do the talking for her. I asked
her a lot of questions, but she remained just as
tight-lipped as yesterday.
dialogues.text:
As before, she let the doll do the talking for her. I asked
her a lot of questions, but she remained just as
tight-lipped as yesterday.

dialogues.jp:
また、気が向いたら来てみよう。彼女の育てて
いる花を見て、そう思うのだった。
dialogues.en:
Looking at the flower she was raising, I knew one thing for
sure; she'd keep coming back here.
dialogues.text:
Looking at the flower she was raising, I knew one thing for
sure; she'd keep coming back here.
